> A compact, standalone barcode terminal for tracking school club attendance. Students scan the barcode on their existing school ID card, and the terminal sends the scan over Wi-Fi to a backend server that records attendance (to be built later). The whole device sits on a single custom PCB. An ESP32-S3 microcontroller handles Wi-Fi and control, a dedicated barcode scanner module reads the cards, and a small display, buzzer, and status LEDs give instant feedback on whether the scan worked. It runs on a rechargeable LiPo battery, charges over USB-C, and keeps working while plugged in, so you can carry it to any club meeting without needing an outlet.
